title: CHU de Guadeloupe hit by a cyberattack; plan blanc triggered and non-urgent care postponed
date_note: RCI (22 November) says the hospital has been under attack since 21h on Saturday evening, 21 November (local time).
geo_basis: hospital's Pointe-à-Pitre site, named by RCI as one of the three affected sites
summary: RCI reported that the CHU de la Guadeloupe has been under cyberattack since Saturday evening, 21 November, with telephone, imaging and software down. La 1ère reported director Eric Guyader as saying an IT provider of the hospital was hacked first, that part of the databases were encrypted, and that the plan blanc is triggered with some care cancelled until Friday 27 November inclusive.
plain: The main hospital in Guadeloupe was hit by a cyberattack on Saturday night. Phones, imaging and software are down, and the hospital has put off some care until 27 November.
exec: A regional hospital lost phones, imaging and software to a cyberattack and postponed non-urgent care, a reminder to test downtime procedures.
action: As La 1ère relays, the SAMU head advises against going to the hospital without first calling the emergency medical line; urgent and priority care continues.

evidence.quote: Une partie des bases de données de l'établissement a été chiffrée

key_findings: Cyberattack since 21h Saturday 21 November; crisis cell set up
Telephone, imaging, non-urgent biology, printers and software out at the Pointe-à-Pitre, Perrin and Palais Royal sites
Director Eric Guyader: first exchanges with ANSSI were not encouraging; restoring software and databases will be difficult and not done within 2 or 3 days; non-urgent activity postponed for the week

validation.note: Two publishers (RCI, La 1ère Guadeloupe) each report the attack from 21 November and director Eric Guyader's statements; the CHU's own notice was not read. The provider-compromise account is the director's, relayed conditionally by La 1ère.

review.note: stronger than the source: report key finding said ANSSI judges the attack serious; RCI says first exchanges with ANSSI were not encouraging. Title, date, 21h Saturday, 27 Nov, encrypted databases, provider-first account, call-15 advice and evidence quotes verified on RCI and La 1ère
